grounds.quote: The actual prior user topic is espionage terminology; this current request asks for independent randomized scene tests using the attached image. Arm A independently drew a covered railway flower-stall contact scene. I compared a direct face-to-face envelope exchange with an apparently ordinary flower purchase containing a small, visibly traceable paper handoff; the latter gives the same contact meaning more tension through competing public attentions. The viewer should first feel the reference-guided woman's controlled presence, then notice the suspended transfer and wonder why the two refuse eye contact. These staging choices are authorial and replaceable, not constraints supplied by the user. Reference guides facial appearance and short black bob only; no identity, biography or age is inferred. Saved controls are sensual 1, fetish 0, surreal 0 and creativity 1, so subtle personal magnetism supports a restrained plausible scene.
